Question 4
?

Given g(x,y)=ln⁡(xy)+cos⁡(y2), find ∇g(x,y).

a
 1x i+(1y−2ysin⁡(y2)) j
b
 1x i+2y(1y−sin⁡(y2)) j
c
 1x i+1y j
d
 1x i+(1y+2ysin⁡y) j
e
 x i+(y−2sin⁡(y2)) j
